summary: Hotel reservation details for people attending the Network Working Group meeting in Cambridge, including the nightly room rate and how to cancel.

plainLanguage.summary: This RFC gives hotel details for Network Working Group meeting attendees. It states the room rate and explains how and when to cancel a reservation.

questions: where were nwg meeting attendees staying

subtitle: Hotel reservation details for Network Working Group meeting attendees.

tldr.problem: Attendees of the Network Working Group meeting in Cambridge needed lodging and cancellation instructions.
tldr.mechanism: Project MAC arranged guaranteed-arrival reservations at the Hotel Sonesta and published the price and cancellation procedure.
tldr.outcome: Attendees were asked to cancel by 6 P.M. on the reservation date, using different contacts for specified dates.

today: RFC 245 is a meeting lodging notice published in October 1971. The unit metadata lists its status as Unknown.

sections.title: Hotel and Room Rate
sections.content: Project MAC arranged guaranteed-arrival reservations at the Hotel Sonesta in Cambridge, Massachusetts, for attendees who had made reservations through Project MAC. A single room cost $23.00 per night.
sections.plainLanguage: Attendees with reservations through Project MAC could stay at the Hotel Sonesta in Cambridge. A single room cost $23.00 per night.

sections.title: Cancellation Instructions
sections.content:
The hotel had to be notified of a cancellation before 6 P.M. on the day of the reservation. For reservations on October 9, 10 or 11, attendees were to call the hotel directly.

For other dates, cancellations could be handled by Carol Falls at extension 1450.
sections.plainLanguage: To cancel, notify the hotel before 6 P.M. on the reservation day. For October 9, 10 or 11, call the hotel; at other times, contact Carol Falls.

sections.title: Reservation Contacts
sections.content: The notice provides a direct procedure for the listed reservation dates and a Project MAC contact for other cancellations. It concerns lodging arrangements for the Network Working Group meeting.
sections.plainLanguage: The notice separates cancellation contacts by date. Attendees were expected to use the stated contact for their reservation.
